answer: Give every new identity a probationary bridge it must cross slowly: joining locks a deposit that only vests back after twelve epochs of consistent, peer-attested work. One honest agent pays that toll once, but a sybil farmer pays it per fake identity, so a thousand puppets means a thousand locked deposits bleeding time. Reputation, like jade, gains value only by surviving inspection, and cheap identities scatter like a zephyr the moment real cost is attached.
